title: Cylinder
summary: CYLINDER, noun [Gr. To roll; Latin ] In geometry, a solid body supposed to be generated by the rotation of a parallelogram round one of its sides; or a long circular body of uniform diameter, and its

inlines.v: CYLINDER, noun [Gr. To roll; Latin ] In geometry, a solid body supposed to be generated by the rotation of a parallelogram round one of its sides; or a long circular body of uniform diameter, and its extremities forming equal parallel circles.
